ValidationRule.description: Shift windows (HOUR/MINUTE math vs weekly hours), skill requirements per grade (INCLUDES/PICKLISTCOUNT), on-site distance limit per grade (DISTANCE in km), and salary/review change freezes after termination.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Shift_Start__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Shift_End__c)), OR( Shift_End__c <= Shift_Start__c, OR(HOUR(Shift_Start__c) >= 22, HOUR(Shift_Start__c) < 6), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Weekly_Hours__c)), ABS((HOUR(Shift_End__c) * 60 + MINUTE(Shift_End__c) - HOUR(Shift_Start__c) * 60 - MINUTE(Shift_Start__c)) / 60 - Weekly_Hours__c / 5) > 1 ) ) ), AND( CASE(TEXT(Grade__c), 'Senior', 1, 'Staff', 1, 'Principal', 1, 'Director', 1, 0) = 1, OR( PICKLISTCOUNT(Skills__c) < 2, NOT(OR(INCLUDES(Skills__c, 'Integration'), INCLUDES(Skills__c, 'Security'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Grade__c, 'Director'), NOT(INCLUDES(Skills__c, 'Data'))) ) ), AND(ISPICKVAL(Employment_Type__c, 'Intern'), INCLUDES(Skills__c, 'Security')), AND( NOT(Is_Remote__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Office_Location__latitude__s)), NOT(ISBLANK(Home_Location__latitude__s)), DISTANCE(Office_Location__c, Home_Location__c, 'km') > CASE(TEXT(Grade__c), 'Director', 320, 'Principal', 240, 190) ), AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Termination_Date__c))), ISCHANGED(Salary__c)), AND(ISCHANGED(Last_Review_At__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Last_Review_At__c))), Last_Review_At__c < PRIORVALUE(Last_Review_At__c)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Shift, skills, location or post-termination change rules were violated.
